tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind everything. Text and `accent` read on it at 4.5:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, navbar, sidebar, calendar. Body text (`text`, `text-muted`, `accent`) reads on it.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Modals, toasts, drawers and menus. Same as `surface` in light (elevation comes from `shadow-lg`); one step lighter in dark, where shadows are invisible.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Input fields, table header row, segmented-control track, disabled controls, skeleton blocks. `text`, `text-muted` and `accent` all read on it at 4.5:1 or better.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind modals and the mobile drawer. Not a text ground.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and card outlines. Below 3:1 on purpose: never use it as the only edge of an interactive control (use `border-strong`).

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Edge of interactive controls: input, select, textarea, checkbox box, switch track (off), slot chip, secondary button. At least 3:1 on `surface`, `surface-sunken` and `bg` in both themes (WCAG 1.4.11).

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text, headings, icons that carry meaning. On `bg`, `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken` and every status tint.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, hints, placeholders, table header labels, inactive nav items. 4.5:1 or better on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken` and `accent-soft`. Replaces the slate #475569, which clashed with the green neutrals.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary action fill, links, selected states, focus. Light: #166534 (white text 7.1:1). Dark: #8fb596, a slightly greener eucalyptus than the old #8ba88e; as text it reads on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-sunken` at 4.5:1 or better, and as a button fill it takes DARK text (`on-accent`), never white.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of the primary button. Light goes darker, dark goes lighter. `on-accent` reads on it at 4.5:1 or better.

tokens.name: accent-active
tokens.usage: Pressed fill of the primary button. `on-accent` reads on it at 4.5:1 or better.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for hover rows, selected cards, active nav item, ghost/secondary hover. `text`, `text-muted` and `accent` read on it.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid `accent` fill (primary button, selected slot, checked checkbox, switch thumb). White in light, near-black green in dark. Never hardcode #fff.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline: 2px solid, 2px offset. At least 3:1 on `bg`, `surface` and `surface-sunken` in both themes.

tokens.name: brand-accent
tokens.usage: Brand orange. ONLY the "Be" in the wordmark, marketing decoration and illustrations. Never for state, never for text smaller than 24px. 3:1 or better on `bg`, `surface` and `surface-raised` (large display text). Split out of the old `--warning`.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons (confirmed, saved). 4.5:1 or better on `surface`, `bg`, `surface-sunken` and `success-bg`.

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind success alerts and the Confirmed badge. `success` and `text` read on it.

tokens.name: success-border
tokens.usage: Outline of success alerts and badges. Decorative; the icon and label carry the meaning.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons (pending, expiring, careful). Amber-brown in light so it passes as text. 4.5:1 or better on `surface`, `bg`, `surface-sunken` and `warning-bg`. Not the brand orange.

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind warning alerts and the Pending badge. `warning` and `text` read on it.

tokens.name: warning-border
tokens.usage: Outline of warning alerts and badges. Decorative.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text, error borders, destructive button fill. Light: white text on it passes. Dark: lighter coral, so the filled button takes `on-danger` (dark) text. Replaces `--error` and `--red` (one token, themed).

tokens.name: danger-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of the danger button. `on-danger` reads on it at 4.5:1 or better.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid `danger` fill.

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind error alerts and the No-show badge. `danger` and `text` read on it.

tokens.name: danger-border
tokens.usage: Outline of error alerts and badges. Decorative.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Info text and icons (completed, tips, neutral notices). 4.5:1 or better on `surface`, `bg`, `surface-sunken` and `info-bg`.

tokens.name: info-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind info alerts and the Completed badge. `info` and `text` read on it.

tokens.name: info-border
tokens.usage: Outline of info alerts and badges. Decorative.

color.palettesUsage: App side only: `data-palette` on `<html>`, set by `AppPalette` in the app layouts. A set overrides the brand and neutral roles (and the tinted shadows); the status roles (`success`, `warning`, `danger`, `info`) are the same in every set. Body text, muted text and accent read at 4.5:1 or better on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-sunken` and `accent-soft` in every set and theme.

styles.name: t-display
styles.usage: Landing hero only (fs-3xl). One per page.

styles.name: t-title
styles.usage: Page title, h1 (fs-2xl). One per page.

styles.name: t-body
styles.sample: Pick a time that suits you. You can change it later.
styles.usage: Default body copy and input text (fs-base).

styles.name: t-caption
styles.usage: Badges, group labels, table headers (fs-xs). Set uppercase with the .label-caps helper.

styles.name: t-wordmark
styles.usage: Wordmark only. Use the .wordmark component, with "Be" in brand-accent. Never for headings.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, tight chip padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside a component (icon + text, label + field).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control inner padding (textarea, chips), gap between list items.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap between related elements, page gutter on phones, input side padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between groups inside a section, page gutter on desktop, button side padding (md).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between sections, large button side padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Section gap on desktop, empty-state vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Large block separation, modal top margin.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Landing page section rhythm only.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkbox box, small tags, focus-ring inner corners.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, selects, textareas, alerts, nav items, table container. The existing --radius.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Modals, bottom sheets, date picker, large feature cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, badges, tabs (segmented), slot chips, switch track.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars, icon-only round buttons, switch thumb, step markers.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Elevation 1: cards that lift on hover, switch thumb, segmented-control selected tab.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Elevation 2: dropdowns, navbar menu panel, hovered interactive cards.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Elevation 3: modals, drawers, toasts. Dark adds a 1px light hairline because black shadows vanish on dark surfaces.

tokens.name: shadow-accent
tokens.usage: Glow under the primary button on hover. Replaces the ad-hoc accent-tinted button shadows.

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: Soft accent halo for a featured card (selected plan, hero preview). Use once per screen.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets that sit on the page without a backdrop (booking detail panel on phones). Casts upward; dark adds the same hairline as shadow-lg.

tokens.name: motion-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, focus, press feedback.

tokens.name: motion-base
tokens.usage: Toggles, tabs, drawers, toast enter.

tokens.name: motion-slow
tokens.usage: Modal and sheet enter. Nothing is slower.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Default easing for everything that moves in or changes state.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Elements leaving (toast dismiss, modal close).

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Phone to tablet. Container query for the table card layout, modal sheet to centered dialog, toast region to bottom-right. CSS variables cannot be used in media queries: write 640px literally.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Tablet to desktop. Sidebar switches from drawer to fixed rail, navbar from menu button to inline links. Consume in JS (matchMedia) and toggle `.is-compact`.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Wide desktop. Only the max width of the content column (72rem) and landing sections change.

tokens.name: fs-xs
tokens.usage: 12px. Badges, captions, table header labels. Never smaller.

tokens.name: fs-sm
tokens.usage: 14px. Secondary text, hints, small buttons, table cells, nav items.

tokens.name: fs-base
tokens.usage: 16px. Body text, inputs (16px prevents iOS zoom on focus), default button.

tokens.name: fs-lg
tokens.usage: 18px. Card titles, large button, lead paragraph.

tokens.name: fs-xl
tokens.usage: 24px. Section headings, modal title on desktop.

tokens.name: fs-2xl
tokens.usage: 32px. Page title.

tokens.name: fs-3xl
tokens.usage: 48px. Landing hero only. On phones use clamp(2.25rem, 9vw, 3rem).

tokens.name: lh-xs

tokens.name: lh-sm

tokens.name: lh-base
tokens.usage: Paired with fs-base (24px).

tokens.name: lh-lg
tokens.usage: Paired with fs-lg (28px).

tokens.name: lh-xl
tokens.usage: Paired with fs-xl (32px).

tokens.name: lh-2xl
tokens.usage: Paired with fs-2xl (36px).

tokens.name: lh-3xl
tokens.usage: Paired with fs-3xl (48px).

tokens.name: fw-black
